name: dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.recommendations
title: Catalog Recommendations
description: Extends Catalog Search with anchored relations: items similar to, complementary to, or substitutes for the anchors the Platform names in `references`. Responses reuse the Catalog Search response unchanged.

relation_policy.title: Relation Policy
relation_policy.description: Policy for one supported relation, keyed by the value a Platform sends in `purpose`. An empty object means the value is supported with no advertised limits.

references.description: Anchor kinds this Business accepts for this relation, keyed by kind, each with its limits. Absent means `id` with `max` 1. A kind that is absent is not accepted; a reference of an unlisted kind is dropped with an informational `unsupported_reference` message. Kinds listed together MAY appear together in one request, each bounded by its own `max`.

reference_kind_policy.title: Reference Kind Policy
reference_kind_policy.description: Limits for one anchor kind under one relation. Extensions that define a kind MAY add kind-specific fields (for example accepted media types and a byte limit for an inline image).

max.description: Maximum references of this kind the Business processes per request. When a request carries more, the Business processes the first `max` in request order and includes an informational `batch_limit_applied` message.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: One anchor for the request. Carries exactly one anchor kind. This extension defines `id`. Other extensions define further kinds as additional properties and SHOULD name them with reverse-domain keys; a Business advertises the kinds it accepts per relation in `config.relations`. A reference whose kind the Business does not accept is dropped with an informational `unsupported_reference` message.

id.description: Product or variant identifier. Resolution follows Catalog Lookup's supported identifiers.

relations.description: Supported relations, keyed by the value a Platform sends in `purpose` (e.g., `search`, `similar`, `complementary`, `substitute`). A Platform MUST NOT send a `purpose` value other than `search` that is absent from this map. `search` is always supported; listing it advertises which anchor kinds plain search accepts as ranking inputs (absent: none).

recommendations_search_request.title: Catalog Search Request with Recommendations
recommendations_search_request.description: Catalog search request extended with a purpose naming a relation to the referenced items.

purpose.description: Relation the results bear to the references. Well-known values: `search` (default when omitted), `similar`, `complementary`, `substitute`. A Platform MUST NOT send a value other than `search` unless the Business lists it in `config.relations`. A Business MUST NOT ignore `purpose`; a value it has not advertised yields an `unsupported_purpose` error message, never a general search.

references.description: Anchors for the request. Under `search` (the default) they are ranking inputs combined with `query` when the Business supports the combination (otherwise it reports the input it did not use with an informational `unsupported_combination` message), and nothing is excluded. Under any other relation they are the subject: results bear that relation to them and catalog anchors are never returned. Each reference carries one anchor kind; which kinds a Business accepts for a relation is advertised in `config.relations.<relation>.references`.
Anchors the results resemble. Multiple references form one joint anchor set; results need not resemble every anchor.
Anchors the results go with (for example, a product being viewed or the lines of a cart). Multiple references form one joint anchor set. The product of every catalog anchor is excluded from results.

The item being replaced, named by `id` (the default accepted kind). The Business processes up to `config.relations.substitute.references.id.max` references (default 1); when several are processed, the response does not say which result replaces which. An `id` that resolves to more than one product or variant is dropped with an informational `ambiguous_reference` message. The item's attributes guide relevance and are not matching constraints.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with recommendations (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

platform_schema.title: Catalog Recommendations (Platform)
platform_schema.description: Platform declaration for catalog recommendations. No platform config is required.

business_schema.title: Catalog Recommendations (Business)
business_schema.description: Business declaration for catalog recommendations. Businesses list the relations they support in `config.relations`.
